zh: 设置页「输入区」页「重绘模型选择器」下面多一项「模型描述」，默认开启：开着时一级列表的每个模型名下面写一行说明，关掉后每一行只剩模型名。
en: The Composer tab gains a Model descriptions switch under Redraw the model picker, on by default: while it is on each model in the picker's first level carries a line under its name saying what the model is, and off leaves every row with the model's name alone.
